mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate labor market tightening, reducing inflationary pressures and boosting growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 6.0%, or the effect persists without a clear positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2.0% AND Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) exceeds its previous month's value, accommodative monetary policy and strong demand converge, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction does not predict positive returns (p > 0.05) when both conditions are met, or the effect is inconsistent across regimes.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) amplifies accommodative policy, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as market anticipates prolonged growth.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in late-cycle expansions but 60-day returns remain non-positive (p > 0.05), or the regime shift to contraction occurs without the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the Supply Index (INDPRO) exceeds 95.0, signaling potential oversupply or weak demand, investors anticipate inflationary pressures subsiding, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 95.0 but 20-day returns do not turn negative (p > 0.05), or the effect is isolated to short-term fluctuations.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 5.0% and decline in Payroll Employment (PAYEMS) below 131,043.0 (previous month's value) indicates a tightening labor market, prompting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors expect growth.
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05) when both conditions occur, or the effect is regime-dependent.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Supply Index (INDPRO) over the past month signals contractionary pressures, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate demand recovery.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines in deflationary phases but 60-day returns remain non-positive (p > 0.05), or the regime shifts unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as higher interest rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises in a tightening cycle but 20-day returns do not turn negative (p > 0.05), or the effect is inconsistent across cycles.
